feedUrls.title: Feed or site URLs
feedUrls.description: RSS/Atom feed URLs, one per line. Plain website URLs work too - the actor finds the site's feed automatically (link tag, then common paths like /feed).

maxPerFeed.title: Items per feed
maxPerFeed.description: How many items to return per feed, in feed order (feeds put newest first).

sinceDays.title: Published within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only items published in the last N days. 0 = everything the feed carries. Items without a parseable date are kept.

includeFullContent.title: Include full content HTML
includeFullContent.description: Include the item's full HTML content when the feed carries it (content:encoded / Atom content). Rows get much bigger; the plain-text summary is always included.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new items only
newOnly.description: Remember items already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a schedule to turn any site's feed into a new-post alert feed - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total across all feeds.
